discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 142d1df89. Height-delta compensation is gone; `Conversation` now records a reading anchor (the first row intersecting the viewport top, plus its offset) on each reader scroll and restores that row to the same offset after every resize. Growth below the anchor produces zero drift, so streaming under a reader no longer moves them. Tests: `keeps the row under the reader still when content below them grows` and `absorbs a height change above the reader into scrollTop`.

Fixed in 142d1df89. `handleKeyDown` returns early unless `event.target === viewport`, so arrow keys inside a focused child control (message action buttons, disclosure triggers) no longer un-pin. Test: `ignores arrow keys aimed at a focused child control`.
